source: OpenHands automation service, issue_comment.created automations, captured 2026-10-07
note: The pre-guard filters the deploy script receives, and the guarded filter each must become (`expected` is the live value re-read from the service on 2026-10-07). This is a SNAPSHOT: it pins what the deploy script composes, not what the service holds now — a backend edit that drops the clause re-arms the loop without failing this test. The live check for that is `deploy-automation-loop-guard.py verify`, run weekly by .github/workflows/automation-loop-guard.yml.

automations.name: SDLC 20 · Issue clarifier
automations.filter: glob(repository.full_name, 'ypcipansor/cipansor') && contains(issue.labels[].name, 'needs-info') && !icontains(comment.body, 'This comment was created by an AI agent')
automations.expected: (glob(repository.full_name, 'ypcipansor/cipansor') && contains(issue.labels[].name, 'needs-info') && !icontains(comment.body, 'This comment was created by an AI agent')) && !icontains(comment.body, 'AI agent (OpenHands)')

automations.filter: glob(repository.full_name, 'ypcipansor/cipansor') && (contains(issue.labels[].name, 'pending-maintainer') || contains(issue.labels[].name, 'needs-info')) && !icontains(comment.body, 'This comment was created by an AI agent')
automations.expected: (glob(repository.full_name, 'ypcipansor/cipansor') && (contains(issue.labels[].name, 'pending-maintainer') || contains(issue.labels[].name, 'needs-info')) && !icontains(comment.body, 'This comment was created by an AI agent')) && !icontains(comment.body, 'AI agent (OpenHands)')
